primary_task: Deploy applications/infrastructure to Cloudflare (Workers, Pages, etc.) using wrangler.

requirements.name: wrangler
requirements.evidence: Verify auth before `wrangler deploy`, `wrangler pages deploy` ... npx wrangler whoami
requirements.check: command -v wrangler; command -v npx; npm view wrangler version

requirements.name: api.cloudflare.com
requirements.evidence: The deploy requires ... network access to deploy to Cloudflare

requirements.name: cloudflare
requirements.evidence: Authentication (Required Before Deploy) ... wrangler login ... or Set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN

notes: wrangler login OAuth would also need dash.cloudflare.com, which is blocked (403). sandbox_permissions escalation does not apply to this container's egress policy.
